Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL221959 to include the parent and all salts. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then compound_records.record_id to activities.record_id, and compound_records.doc_id to docs.doc_id. Join assays via activities.assay_id and target_dictionary via assays.tid. Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter for target CHEMBL2971 and activities with standard_type IC50 and standard_units nM. Return all rows without deduplication and without a row limit.
